definition: Instinct is a personal artificial intelligence agent developed by Spear Street Technology, Inc., a San Francisco-based startup founded by Noah Shinn.
details: The agent is reached by text message or phone call rather than through a dedicated app. As of September 2026 the product is in an invite-only private access programme.

explainer.lead: Instinct is a personal AI agent that users reach by text message or phone call instead of through a dedicated app. Its phone-based interface matters because it puts an AI assistant on channels people already use.

tiers.eli5: Instead of installing a special app, you just text or call it like a friend, and it acts as your helper.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers integrating with Instinct must design for messaging and voice channels rather than an app SDK. A pitfall is that access is limited: as of September 2026 it is only available through an invite-only private access programme.
tiers.paperLevel: Instinct is a personal artificial intelligence agent developed by Spear Street Technology, Inc., a San Francisco-based startup founded by Noah Shinn. Access is via text message or phone call rather than an app, and the product is invite-only.

explainer.example: A user texts Instinct on their phone to ask for help, and the agent replies in the same message thread instead of requiring an app install.
